blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 2 vegan soft chews 30 minutes before bedtime as Melatonin may cause drowsiness. For best results, allow yourself to sleep more than 6 hours. This product is intended for short term, occasional use only. Do not exceed recommended dosage.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children. For adults only. Not intended for use by pregnant or lactating women. Consult your doctor before using this product if you have a medical condition, including kidney disease, or if you are currently on medication. Discontinue use if any adverse reactions occur. Consumption above recommended dosage may impair ability to drive a motor vehicle or operate heavy equipment. Tamper evident: do not use if safety seal is broken or missing. Store in a cool, dry place. avoid excessive heat.
